summary: The target throughput utilization setting lets you tune the concurrent request level that triggers new instances.
extended_definition: The target throughput utilization setting lets you tune the concurrent request level that triggers new instances.

supporting_pages.title: "appengine-web.xml reference \_|\_ App Engine standard environment \_|\_\
evidence_snippets: When the number of concurrent requests reaches a value equal to max-concurrent-requests times target-throughput-utilization , the scheduler starts a new instance. <max-instances> Optional.
For example, a value of 0.7 means that new instances will be started after CPU usage reaches 70 percent. <target-throughput-utilization> Optional.
